name: NGC 5371, SN 2020bio field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5371, a spiral galaxy that hosted the supernova SN 2020bio, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2020biohost-hubble
story: SN 2020bio was a double-peaked Type IIb supernova, caught within a day of its explosion in this spiral galaxy. Hubble looked back at the site later to study the explosion's aftermath and its surroundings.

claims.text: SN 2020bio exploded in the spiral galaxy NGC 5371
SN 2020bio is a double-peaked Type IIb supernova discovered within a day of explosion
Hubble program 16239 takes late-time images of nearby supernovae to study the explosions and their environments; SN2020BIO is a target
